method: longitude-band geographic split; centroid assignment; straddlers dropped; train-side buffer 0.15 deg around all eval bands; exact shapely zero-overlap verified
clauses: Per-pixel nodata masking (finite in all 15 channels) MUST be applied in loss AND all reported metrics.
Normalization statistics and class weights MUST be computed on TRAIN patches only.
EAST set is auxiliary out-of-distribution evaluation ONLY: never used for training, model selection, or early stopping; reported once in the final results.
TEST set is evaluated exactly once, after model selection on VAL.
Checkpoint selection on VAL uses a smoothed/composite criterion (e.g. debris IoU averaged over a window), not a single-evaluation peak (118 debris patches -> ~4-5pp SE).

TRAIN is extensible under the rule: new background patches may be added later iff they pass the identical assignment rule (validity >= 0.30, no straddling, outside all dilated eval slabs). Eval lists are immutable.
